summary.text: Myriad Beings Assimilation Transformation is Beast Calamity Immortal's immortal killer move. It adds transformation path dao marks and turns other dao marks into transformation path dao marks.

claims.text: After leaving Beast Calamity grotto-heaven, Fang Yuan names the immortal killer move Myriad Beings Assimilation Transformation and treats it as Beast Calamity Immortal’s unique method. The move expends an enormous amount of immortal essence and needs abundant positive, righteous emotions; that cost explains the nature of Combat Beast Warriors in Beast Calamity grotto-heaven. Four Immortal Gu form the move; the core is rank eight adaptation Immortal Gu, Beast Calamity Immortal’s vital Gu, and the other three are rank seven.

Desolate beasts, ancient desolate beasts, and even a star sea snail’s shell can feed the move. Beast Calamity Immortal used it on the whole grotto-heaven, so the local Gu Immortals do not each grasp it, yet in extremity the grotto-heaven could merge with them through the move for temporary rank eight battle strength.
Any living being that enters Beast Calamity grotto-heaven is affected by myriad beings assimilation transformation and turns into a beast calamity.
Gu Masters can use the move’s power to transform inside, spending positive emotions in the process, so Combat Beast Envoys are usually people with rich positive emotions.
Transformation path has two supreme profundities: undergoing myriad changes as one willed, and gathering the power of all paths into one, like myriad beings assimilation transformation.

Before clashing with Duke Long, Fang Yuan has already used the move; Beast Calamity Immortal’s ultimate method holds transformation path’s highest profundity. Qi path, refinement path, and transformation path dao marks alone give him one million five hundred thousand transformation path dao marks; when he transforms into a bandit monkey those become strength path dao marks and let him trade blows with Duke Long.

Fang Yuan reminds himself that after getting an earth vein he can no longer use myriad beings assimilation transformation. The move can even influence heaven path dao marks, so tribulations turn into beast calamities, but transforming too many dao marks would wreck the sovereign immortal aperture’s habitat; with his current dao mark count a full conversion is unusable, and a partial conversion would not matter against venerables.
